# VB Insulation

> > VB Insulation is a leading supplier of spray foam insulation products, kits, and accessories for residential and commercial applications across North America.

VB Insulation specializes in closed-cell and open-cell spray foam insulation solutions, featuring the Vega Bond product line with single-component and two-component formulations. The company provides comprehensive product catalogs, technical resources, and customer support for DIY and professional contractors.

## Key Topics

- Spray Foam Insulation
- Closed Cell Foam
- Open Cell Foam
- Vega Bond
- Vega Bond Purplecoat
- Fire Block Spray Foam
- Single-Component Foam
- Insulation Kits
- Thermal Insulation
- Spray Foam Safety
- Construction Adhesives
- Safety Equipment
- Packing Foam
- DIY Insulation

- [Closed-Cell Spray Foam Kits](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/closed-cell-kits): Closed-cell spray foam kits including Vega Bond product lines
- [Vega Bond Single Component Spray Foam Kit](https://vbinsulation.com/products/vega-bond-single-component-spray-foam-kit-12-pack-240-board-feet-applicator-not-included): Vega Bond Purplecoat 12-pack spray foam kit product page
- [Vega PRO Foams](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/vega-pro-foams): Vega PRO Foams product collection for closed and open cell foam
- [Open Cell Spray Foam Insulation](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/open-cell-spray-foam): Open cell spray foam insulation product collection
- [Fire Block Spray Foams](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/fire-block-foams): Fire Block closed-cell spray foam products for safety
- [Single-Component Foam Insulation](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/single-component-foam): Single-component ready-to-use spray foam products

- [Insulation Adhesives](https://vbinsulation.com/collections/adhesives): Insulation adhesives including Vega Bond V7 and stone adhesive
